_comment: client_id is NOT secret (it's the public half of a Discord OAuth2 app, safe to publish) but it must be a REAL Discord Application's client ID for the invite link to work. This placeholder must be replaced by the server owner after they register the bot in the Discord Developer Portal - see discord-release-bot/README.md for the exact steps. permissions must stay in sync with discord-release-bot/bot/config.py's Config.invite_url. 2026-09-01: raised from 84992 to 309237730304 when /bug was added - the four original permissions (View Channels + Send Messages + Embed Links + Read Message History = 84992) plus Create Public Threads (1<<35) and Send Messages in Threads (1<<38), so each bug report gets its own thread. Still NOT Administrator. Servers that installed the bot before this must click the invite link once more; without it reports still post, just without threads.
